description: Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka - The Name of Person or Category of Person to Whom the Certificate of Exemptions were Granted.
reasoning: This gazette content is a legal/regulatory notice issued by the Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka under Section 10(3) of the Sri Lanka Electricity Act, No. 20 of 2009 (amended). It involves the issuance of Certificates of Exemption from licensing requirements for electricity distribution and supply, which constitutes regulatory action and falls under legal/regulatory framework matters rather than government personnel or structural changes.
